items.statement: The submitted calculation uses the public C20H17ClN6OS neutral singlet thione connectivity and preserves the source-label mapping for the requested geometry selectors.
items.expected: Identity, charge, multiplicity, tautomer and mapping are explicitly verified.

items.statement: Each compared model is independently optimized and its stationarity/convergence is tested.
items.expected: Both model records contain convergence and minimum validation evidence, or honestly identify a bounded failure.

items.statement: The report extracts the source-defined bond lengths, bond angles and torsions and computes model-wise errors against SCXRD.
items.expected: All available requested rows are reported with units and MAE/RMSE; torsions use circular differences.

items.statement: The source reports CAM-B3LYP as more accurate than B3LYP for geometrical parameters and vibrational analysis.
items.expected: The conclusion identifies CAM-B3LYP as the better overall agreement model within the tested comparison, while stating the metric and scope.
